name: The Shattered Salute
summary: The Shattered Salute is an initiation ritual overseen by Shenthul within the Cleft of Shadows in Orgrimmar. By learning this distinct sign of recognition, budding rogues are taught how to safely identify fellow operatives of the Shattered Hand in the field.

sections.title: Signs and Shadows
sections.body: Within the dark tunnels of the Cleft of Shadows, the Shattered Hand operates as the clandestine intelligence and assassination arm of Thrall's Horde. Given the dangerous and secretive nature of their assignments, operatives cannot rely on overt banners or standard military heraldry. Shenthul instructs newly inducted rogues in the Shattered Salute, a specific gesture meant to serve as an unmistakable, silent signal among allies.

sections.title: Preparation for the Field
sections.body: Mastering the salute is not merely a ceremonial exercise; it is vital tradecraft. Rogue agents sent into perilous territory or tasked with infiltrating rival factions must verify contacts without alerting bystanders or targets. Shenthul insists that an operative be able to recognize and mirror the gesture effortlessly before entrusting them with covert fieldwork.

faq.q: What is the purpose of the Shattered Salute?
aliases: why do i need the salute
faq.answer: The Shattered Salute serves as a covert recognition signal among members of the Shattered Hand. It allows operatives to identify one another in deep cover or hostile territory without exposing their true affiliations to outsiders.

aliases: where do i learn the salute
faq.answer: The salute is taught by Shenthul, a rogue trainer stationed deep within the Cleft of Shadows beneath Orgrimmar.
It is used by the Shattered Hand, an order of orcish rogues, spies, and assassins that serves the modern Horde from the shadows of Orgrimmar.

faq.q: Why is learning the salute necessary before going into the field?
faq.answer: Operatives sent on infiltration assignments, such as making contact with undercover agents, rely on the salute to avoid blowing their cover or mistaking an enemy for an ally.

faq.q: Where does this training take place?
faq.answer: The training takes place in the Cleft of Shadows, the subterranean district beneath Orgrimmar where rogues, warlocks, and other practitioners of forbidden arts gather away from public scrutiny.

faq.q: What assignment follows after mastering the salute?
faq.answer: Once Shenthul is satisfied with an operative's mastery of the salute, he assigns them to deep cover operations, testing their ability to use the signal to contact agents in the field.

angles.text: For a Horde rogue, mastering the Shattered Hand's secret signals represents the transition from an ordinary cutpurse to a trusted agent of Orgrimmar's intelligence network.
Though Warchief Thrall leads with honor, the Horde relies heavily on the clandestine methods of the Shattered Hand to neutralize threats before they reach the surface.
